scope: Broaden the DXF top-level framing review across normative documentation, independent parser/writer source, peer issue reports, and local behavior; update the plan and add a bounded generated regression without downloading or committing drawing fixtures.

method.kind: Primary-source specification, repository-source, peer-issue, and local generated-control review
localInspection: src/libdxfrw.cpp: dxfRW::processDxf top-level SECTION/name/ENDSEC/EOF state handling
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: generated ASCII/Binary minimal-R12, standard-TABLES, and orphan-TABLE controls
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-129, 7BT.1, validation cadence, and support evidence ledger

evidence.observed: The general structure reference describes sections framed by group-0 SECTION, group-2 section name, and group-0 ENDSEC. The symbol-table example locates TABLE and ENDTAB records inside TABLES.
doesNotEstablish: whether a particular legacy producer omitted wrappers intentionally or accidentally
that an unprovided peer issue sample is conforming DXF
evidence.planUse: Default parser should reject out-of-section table records rather than silently discard them; legacy recovery remains separately gated.

evidence.observed: The table loader expects a table head in the TABLES model. The minimal R12 stream writer can emit an ENTITIES-only document when fixed_tables is false, showing that an absent TABLES section is distinct from a TABLE record outside section framing.
doesNotEstablish: runtime acceptance of libdxfrw-generated controls by ezdxf
a normative statement beyond the Autodesk format documentation
evidence.planUse: Add a generated no-TABLES R12 positive control to prevent over-strict framing changes.

evidence.observed: An open feature request reports older NC/CAM/plotting DXF files with bare tables and proposes warning-backed recovery. The issue provides no producer artifact, version, checksum, or independent reproduction.
doesNotEstablish: the exact group-record sequence or safe resynchronization boundary
conformance or a required general-purpose recovery mode
evidence.planUse: Compatibility lead only. Recovery requires a provenance-bound sample and explicit bounded policy.

evidence.observed: Peer reports describe truncated DXF output despite a successful process status and malformed INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND output; the latter uses ezdxf readback to distinguish parseability and compound-record completeness.
doesNotEstablish: a reproduced peer failure in this checkout
that exit status or self-round-trip is a sufficient output-integrity oracle
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing independent output-closure/readback checkpoint; add no local finding without a local reproducer.

evidence.observed: Before the fix, an unexpected top-level TABLE record could be skipped, later ENTITIES callbacks delivered, and read return success. processDxf now returns BAD_READ_SECTION for invalid top-level framing. Generated ASCII and Binary tests prove acceptance of minimal R12 without TABLES, acceptance of standard TABLES/LAYER and following LINE, and rejection of an out-of-section TABLE, detached group-2 section name, and unmatched ENDSEC before later LINE callbacks.
doesNotEstablish: callback rollback for headers or tables emitted before a later parse error
native CAD acceptance or DWG behavior
evidence.planUse: PAR-129 / 7BT.1: bounded fail-closed correction with the existing fixture target and CTest.

limitations.worktree: Uncommitted; shared checkout contains broad pre-existing user changes. No staging or commit was attempted.
